name: chargesense
description: ChargeSense — a peer-to-peer platform for EV charger sharing with a deterministic FCFS scheduler.

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.dev:memory: concurrently -n mongo,server,client -c magenta,green,cyan "npm --prefix server run mongo:memory" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
